description: Keep Amazon products on a frequent live refresh (every 2-24 hours, depending on plan) for 30 days, so their buy-box price, buy-box seller, stock state and offer count are re-read and kept as a time series. Read the results with list_tracked (all tracked products) or product_dossier (one product). action=stop removes products from your tracked list. Use when the user says 'track this ASIN', 'watch the buy box on these', 'monitor these competitor listings'. No e-mail alerts - ask for the latest points instead. Amazon marketplaces only.

interval.description: Refresh interval (your plan sets the shortest: Starter 24h, Scout 12h, Scout Pro 4h, Scout + Protect 2h).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.
